subject: [PATCH 4/9] mm/gup: split out folio grab-and-store helper

2026-11-23.patch_summary: This patch splits out a helper function, gup_grab_fill_folio_pages(), from the follow_page_pte() function in mm/gup.c. The new function is responsible for grabbing a folio reference and storing pages for the caller, while the original function now only performs safety checks on PTEs. This change improves performance by reducing the number of cache flushes required under the page table lock.
